entities.name: Urza
entities.description: The greatest artificer of all time, whose experiments to find a means to defeat Phyrexia are the focus of the set's story.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A perilous dark domain Urza travels to while seeking weapons against the dark forces that stalk him.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war that began hundreds of years before the set's story, many of whose consequences are only now coming to fruition.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: The origins of which the set's story shows in a flashback.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Met by readers in his student days in the set's story.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Shown at the peak of her power in the set's story.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Protagonist of the previous story, which Urza's Saga departs from in a flashback.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Antagonist of the previous story, which Urza's Saga departs from in a flashback.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A perilous domain Urza travels to.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: A splendid domain Urza travels to.

entities.name: Thran Mana Rig
entities.description: A Thran device Urza discovers at the end of the story told in the Official Guide.

events.summary: The set's story follows Urza as he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him.
events.quote: he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him

events.summary: The story departs from Gerrard and Volrath in a flashback showing the origins of the Legacy, meeting Teferi as a student and Serra at the peak of her power.
events.quote: Urza's Saga departs from the story of Gerrard and Volrath in a flashback, showing the origins of the Legacy

events.summary: The Official Guide presents Urza's story from the explosive end of the Brothers' War to his discovery of the Thran Mana Rig.
events.quote: from the explosive end of the Brothers' War to his discovery of the Thran Mana Rig

relations.note: Urza's experiments aim to find a means to defeat Phyrexia.
relations.quote: Urza’s experiments in finding a means to defeat Phyrexia
